name: Kaeru to Kenki
source:
The protagonist was killed by a man wearing a frog mask────

But in the next moment, he woke up in his own bed as if nothing had happened.

In town, a wish-granting tablet called the “Monolith” and a mysterious liquid known as “Soma” are misleading people, triggering a series of inexplicable incidents.

As he investigates, the protagonist gradually uncovers the secrets of his world—and of himself.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3644110/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
主角被戴着青蛙面具的男人杀死了────

但下一刻，他就在自己的床上醒来了，就像什么事都没有发生过一样。

小镇上，一块名为“巨石”的如意药片和一种名为“索玛”的神秘液体误导了人们，引发了一系列莫名其妙的事件。

随着调查的进行，主角逐渐揭开了他的世界以及他自己的秘密。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3644110/]Steam[/url]]
